name: 皮肤切换器-Skin Changer
author: Gurio
description: 切换角色、卡牌、怪物、先古场景和商人皮肤；多人游戏可按玩家同步角色皮肤、头像和局内外观参数，也可在对局中热切换自己的皮肤。双方都安装同一皮肤时显示所选皮肤，否则使用原皮，不会下载远端皮肤。界面支持 15 种语言，无需重启。 Switch character, card, monster, Ancient, and merchant skins; multiplayer syncs each player's character skin, avatar, and live model/UI transforms, including hot-swapping your own skin during a run. A selected skin is shown only when both players have it installed; otherwise the original is used, with no remote skin downloads. 15-language interface, no restart required.
